profile_method.preparation: python_headroom.prepare; assert validate(run()) for every execution
profile_method.executions: Each version ran sequentially: 7 unprofiled warmups, 10 cProfile executions, 7 further unprofiled executions before adaptive disassembly.
profile_method.accounting: cProfile.getstats entries retained by code object; total self time is sum(entry.inlinetime). Do not aggregate by filename/name/line: generated functions can share all three.
profile_method.caveats: GC enabled; not CPU pinned; profiler overhead changes cost proportions. Self-time shares rank hypotheses, not production savings. Opcode counts are static including cold exits, not dynamic instruction counts.
profile_method.specialization: dis.get_instructions(code, adaptive=True) after unprofiled rewarm; CPython maintains bytecode and inline caches.
